description: External data download with full provenance tracking

datasets.pantheon_plus: Pantheon+SH0ES data + STAT+SYS and STATONLY covariance
datasets.sfipp: SFI++ Tully-Fisher catalog (4,861 galaxies) via VizieR
datasets.jia_hz: Jia et al. 2023 H(z) data (60 measurements)

datasets.hyperleda_vrot: HyperLEDA V_rot for all Pantheon+ hosts (z < 0.06)
datasets.vizier_hyperleda: VizieR VII/237 + VII/238 for V_rot cross-check

data_sources: Curated from peer-reviewed publications (R22, CCHP, MF2023, KP, Anand 2024)
